review_scope: Complete source read of 26 remaining small variable files, including README authoring example, comments, literal values, version branches and variable dependencies. No source execution.
context: All values describe locked source text only, not verified current product behavior or adopted policy. Links and example identities remain inert references; no linked-body review, credentials, runtime rendering, installation, contact, rights clearance or native enforcement is implied. Conditional dependencies require separate version/render assurance. Units and restrictions are preserved only where stated; examples are not deployable configuration.
